description: How the Pinegrap 2026.11 client maps one answer of POST /v1/licenses/verify onto the licence state license_check() keeps in $_SESSION['software']['settings']['license']. There is no fallback to the legacy api2. 'session' is the legacy-shaped answer the existing code consumes (status, error_code, P_end_d) plus the licence card's fields (type, sites_used, sites_total: from a schema-valid 200 only, otherwise '', null, null); 'retry' is what pg_license_check_due() then does with it: an answered state is trusted 12 hours, an unusable one ('' status) is asked again after 15 minutes. Only a schema-valid 200, a 401 application/problem+json answer with code invalid_license and a 403 one with code seats_full or access_blocked change the stored state; every other outcome, any other 401 included, is unusable. 'card' says what the licence card shows. Case ids are stable. Decision table: docs/plan/bridge-matrix.md.

answered.meaning: A non-empty status: trusted for 12 hours.

unusable.meaning: Status '': asked again after 15 minutes; the licence card shows the technical-reason text meanwhile.

card.type: The client's own name (a lang() text of the Pinegrap PR) for demo, premium and enterprise; the code itself, escaped, for any other code; nothing when type is ''. The type decides nothing else.
card.sites: sites_used / sites_total (for example 3 / 5) when both are set; nothing when they are null.

seats_full.en: Every site right of this license is in use; to use it on a new site, first have one of its sites released.
seats_full.tr: Bu lisansın site hakkı dolu; yeni bir site için önce bir siteyi boşalttırın

access_blocked.en: Service access is closed for this site.
access_blocked.tr: Bu site için hizmet erişimi kapatıldı

card.messages_note: Shown for the error_code of the same name. 'tr' is binding; 'en' is the suggested lang() source, which the Pinegrap PR may reword (its Turkish shard carries 'tr').

cases.note: Unknown fields at any level are ignored.
valid_until is the last valid day, inclusive; the existing code shows 0 days left and still valid.
A licence without an end date carries 2099-12-31.
One licence serving several sites: this site holds one of the five rights, three are in use.
A demo licence: one site, 30 days by default.
A type added to the catalog later. The answer stays usable; the card shows the code itself.
Pinegrap derives 'expired' from the past date, as it did with the legacy answer.

An expired or suspended licence gives no right, so a site that holds none gets the status without taking one, and used counts only the sites that hold one: here none. The card shows the numbers as sent; the client compares nothing.
Definitive. The client shows its own text for error_code suspended.
Definitive: the same 'not valid' state the legacy no_match gave.

body.title: Invalid license
body.detail: The license key is not known.

cases.note: For example a proxy on the path dropped the Authorization header; the key itself was not judged.

body.title: Missing credentials
body.detail: The route needs a credential and none was sent.

cases.note: A WAF or proxy page, not a problem object.

Every site right of the licence is held by another site and this site holds none. Definitive for 12 hours; the card shows its own message. The answer names no site and carries no licence data, so the card shows no type or site count. A right is released by Kodpen staff only; the manager can then ask again with Check License.

body.title: Site rights full
body.detail: Every site right of this license is in use.

cases.note: Kodpen closed the licence service for this site or address (scope licence or all). Definitive; the client shows its own message (service access closed for this site).

body.title: Access blocked
body.detail: Access to this service is closed.

cases.note: Before the cutover licence verification is off; the client keeps asking every 15 minutes and does not read Retry-After.

body.title: Not live
body.detail: License verification is not switched on yet.

body.title: Too many requests
body.detail: Too many calls from this address.

cases.note: A proxy page, not a problem object.
Cloudflare 52x pages are HTML.
No answer within the 8-second total (cURL errno 28).
Name resolution or connection refused (cURL errno 6 or 7).
The certificate does not verify (cURL errno 60); the site's TLS setting is never relaxed for this call.
Redirects are never followed.
A client fault (for example a missing X-Pinegrap-Site); nothing is learned about the licence.
A captive portal or WAF page answered 200.

response.body_text: <html><body>Please wait while we check your browser</body></html>

cases.note: A legacy api2 answer is not a v1 answer and is never read as one.
valid_until is never null; a licence without an end date carries 2099-12-31.
License.status names no meaning for a value the client does not know, so the answer is unusable.
The shape before site rights: plan, no type, no sites. Never sent; unusable.
Every licence has at least one right.
